messages.content: my service canada account log in

message.content:
To **log in to My Service Canada Account (MSCA)**, go to the MSCA sign-in page and use the **same sign-in option you used when you registered**: **GCKey**, **Interac® Sign-In Partner**, or a **provincial sign-in** where available.[2][4]

- If you registered with **GCKey**, sign in with your GCKey username and password.[2]
- If you registered with **Interac® Sign-In Partner**, sign in with your online banking login.[2]
- If you registered with a **provincial sign-in**, use that option again to access MSCA.[4]
- If you are not sure which one you used, Service Canada says your sign-in method is tied to your account and user profile, so you must use the same option every time unless you register for another one.[2]

If you do **not** have an account yet, you can register for MSCA through GCKey, a participating bank, or a provincial sign-in depending on your province.[2][4]

If you want, I can also give you the **step-by-step sign-in instructions** for **GCKey** or help you figure out **which login option you used**.
